## 2. Required columns and per-role rules

Core states required columns inside the role text; it is copied unchanged.

- `bars`: R17 chunked BAR delivery on the governed grid of the epoch (intraday bars of the target session for session_reset, daily bars for governed_history); one instrument; positive-volume bars carry positive coherent OHLC, zero-volume proven-empty bars carry null OHLC; a close-only delivery (columns=close) is legal and serves only the close-based technical outputs; completed bars only (end <= market cutoff); every row carries its original known_at, an optional revision id and the adjustment basis; a split_adjusted series also requires the caller adjustment_spec {action_snapshot, anchor, policy_version} and every series declares adjustment_spec.policy_version (D6, PQ-2)

## 5. Coverage, adjustment, scale, known_at and mode rules

- **mode_rule**: known_at and reconstruction availability give identical results: the producer enforces knowledge from the original known_at_ns of every consumed bar in both modes
- **knowledge_readiness**:
  - **K**: K is the knowledge cutoff, distinct from the market cutoff C (the end of the last delivered slot); a bar is KNOWN iff its original known_at_ns is non-null and <= K (== K is known)
  - **revision**: a correction is delivered as the one current version of the bar (identity key excludes the revision id) with the known_at of the correction; a correction known after K is future_knowledge and the original version is NOT used; delivering both versions is DUPLICATE (RF refusal); the I/O layer selects the version known at K, the library never picks between versions
  - **consumed_only**: only slots an output requires are assessed; a null or late known_at on a slot no selected output reads has no effect (KA future_outside_window and future_after_target)
  - **partial_bar**: a bar that has not completed at the market cutoff is never delivered as a row (BOUNDS) and a forming target slot yields future_market, never a value
  - **compact**: ka maps to known_at_ns = K_ns - (100 - ka) seconds with K_ns = C_ns + 100 s; ka 100 is exactly K, 150 is 50 s after it, 50 is 50 s before it
- **defaults_ledger**:
  - **statement**: the library contract has no default value anywhere: every parameter in `producers.*.parameters`, the adjustment basis, the price unit, K, the coverage declaration and the structural context must be supplied; a missing item is INVALID_CONFIG or a typed shared/identity refusal, a missing bar fact is absent_input, unknown_availability or insufficient_history; adjustment_spec.policy_version (and for split_adjusted action_snapshot and anchor) is supplied by the caller and the shared AdjustmentSpec defaults (raw-v1, none) are never applied (PQ-2)
  - **fixture_only_conventions**:
    - default known_at 50 and volume 5 in the compact fixture notation (expanded to explicit values in the canonical wire)
    - slot clock 1.7e18 ns + i*60 s
  - **forbidden_tokens**:
    - K-50
    - KNOWN_DEFAULT
    - default-to-complete
  - **adapter_brief_step**: every EF5 adapter brief must list every default it applies and justify it; the reviewer checks the list against this ledger; the expected list is empty
- **shared_rules_and_terms**:
  - **terms**:
    - **READY**: a slot with a complete, known, coherent bar for the fields the output reads
    - **R17**: governed intraday grid, admission, reset epoch and exact preparation (docs/features/INTRADAY_FOUNDATIONS.md)
    - **E1-E9**: EF4 shared-amendment rulings (docs/ef4/EF4_SHARED_AMENDMENT.md)
    - **C8-C10**: PO merge conditions on E1, E2 and E4 that gate the I/O and worker layers (DECISIONS.md)
    - **PO-1..PO-7**: rulings recorded in open_questions (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-28)
  - **config_rules**:
    - **price_unit**: integer scale 0..18 and a currency (shared PriceUnit; RF39 scale 19); EF5 admission enforces exactly three upper-case letters (PQ-1 c2; RF40 INVALID_UNIT at config); shared PriceUnit unchanged (non-empty string only); divergence stated in EF5_SHARED_AMENDMENT
    - **capability**: only batch compute; update (RF42) and restore (RF43) are UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY as in EF4
    - **epoch_profile**: session_reset or governed_history only (RF19, RF20)
    - **adjustment_vocabulary_v1**: exactly unadjusted and split_adjusted; total mapping to shared AdjustmentSpec for comparison only: unadjusted -> raw, split_adjusted -> split; the basis result field echoes the EF5 label; total_return and every other label is UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT at config (RF41); missing basis stays refused (RF21) split_adjusted maps to the shared AdjustmentSpec(basis=split), which requires a non-none action_snapshot and anchor: the EF5 config for split_adjusted must carry caller-declared adjustment_spec {action_snapshot, anchor} (non-empty, not none; no default); absent or none fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT at config (RF53, RF54); unadjusted needs no spec. PQ-2 recipes RF55-RF57.
- **layer_responsibilities**:
  - **library**: admission of supplied bars and context, slot readiness, exact arithmetic, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic; one shared slot table reused by outputs without coupling their readiness
  - **io**: maps ordered bars, the governed grid, coverage, adjustment basis, original known_at and revision identities exactly as supplied; selects the version known at K; never sorts, fills, imputes, drops, resamples, converts, chooses a window or computes a pattern; the brief lists every default (expected: none)
  - **worker**: routes selected outputs with exact window closure, executes a bounded pattern window without future data, preserves correction and replay scope, persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results are identical including refusal class

## 6. Input-stage refusals

- **refusal_precedence**:
  - **order**:
    - wire
    - shared
    - config
    - version
    - identity
  - **wire**: cell types, row width and int64 range (INVALID_SCHEMA, OVERFLOW)
  - **shared**: validate_batch and require_compatible_inputs: DUPLICATE, INVALID_ORDER, BOUNDS, OHLC and volume INVALID_SCHEMA, rows delivered with coverage not declared for every slot (INVALID_SCHEMA, ruling E2: no default-to-complete; RF15) and partial coverage, where some slots declare coverage and a delivered row has none, is INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY at stage identity (EF5_LIBRARY_ERRATA E-L4; RF59), structural context not delivered (INVALID_SCHEMA)
  - **config**: parameter set, ranges, vocabularies and the E4 span check (INVALID_CONFIG), feature ids (UNKNOWN_FEATURE), price unit and currency (INVALID_UNIT), adjustment (UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT), capability (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY)
  - **version**: policy label (INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION)
  - **identity**: INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY: instrument, session, interval not a governed slot, adjustment basis differing from the config
  - **rule**: a refusal raises the code of the first stage, in this order, that has a fault; a row that fails an earlier stage is not evaluated by a later one; every refusal fixture is a single-fault recipe and the independent expander audits that exactly one (stage, code) pair fires
